job.name: The Breaker (class portrait)
job.paint: A heavy-shouldered fighter mid-stride with a war axe resting on one shoulder, dust kicked up, grinning at the next wall to go through.
job.avoid: a barbarian from a known work · bare-chested pin-up pose
job.section: Raw Power: the Momentum chain, and the Breaker
job.prompt:
Create an original Project Heaven Cry illustration in HEAVENPRINT. Use the attached approved Original 27 and New Faces
images as the painting authority: expressive ink and opaque gouache, deliberate angular form, selective dry-brush
scumbling, restrained hatching, charcoal lost edges and warm ivory accents. Faces have believable anatomy and restrained
stylization and specific emotional acting. Format: 4:5, 800 x 1000 PNG, one character from the chest or waist up, one
visible action, one specific emotion, one useful setting hint behind them; the eye line about 22% from the top. The class
attribute's pigment appears only as one accent (given in the section). No text, frame, UI or watermark; no real-world
person, brand or recognisable character. The portrait shows:

Paint: A heavy-shouldered fighter mid-stride with a war axe resting on one shoulder, dust kicked up, grinning at the next wall to go through.
Avoid: a barbarian from a known work · bare-chested pin-up pose
CAST AND STAGING: Breaker: stocky 35-year-old man with medium tan skin, freckles, a bent broad nose, short wiry copper hair and dark stubble, an unguarded crooked GRIN. Waist-up in strong forward three-quarter stride, plain war AXE resting across ONE shoulder, hand gripping haft at collar height. Fully clothed in worn charcoal padded work jacket with patched leather shoulder guard, not bare chest. Dust rises at lower frame and a broken plaster doorway behind hints at the next wall; no visible victim or attack. Natural iron, ocher cloth, ivory hard accents, broad directional brushwork. Face stays high at22%, axehead fully visible, no branded or recognizable axe.
ACTING SENTENCE: A heavy-shouldered fighter strides toward the next obstacle with an axe on one shoulder, and feels delighted determination.
Rendering follows the approved paintings: visible deliberate angular opaque gouache brush blocks, broken ink contours, selective dry scumbling, quiet charcoal lost edges and warm ivory focal planes. Believable face anatomy with restrained illustration stylization, no photo skin/3D gloss/airbrush, no oversized anime eyes. Borrow rendering, NEVER the identity/face/pose/costume of a reference person. The final small motif reference supplies only the class's equipment/gesture motif; DO NOT paste its emblem/frame into painting. Vertical 4:5, full-bleed opaque RGB painting, chest/waist-up, eye line approximately22% from top, face/decisive hands/tool central80%. One person, action, emotion, useful setting hint. Preserve natural skin/cloth/metal colors; one restrained hot-orange #F68A38 sash edge is the SINGLE ATTRIBUTE ACCENT, never a monochrome wash. No letters, readable glyphs, labels, symbols of real faiths, real insignia, caption, UI, frame, border or watermark.

portrait_cast.acting: A heavy-shouldered fighter strides toward the next obstacle with an axe on one shoulder, and feels delighted determination.
